notes.title: ASCENSION: THE IMMORTAL ALCHEMIST DEMO IN STEAM NEXT FEST
notes.notes:
[b][/b]Ascension: The Immortal Alchemist[b][/b] demo will be available during Steam Next Fest October 14-21 (PT).

Brought to you by a team of 2 (Kiwi ingenuity & German precision) - Experience the cosmos like never before as you explore the mysteries of the seven spheres in your search for the tablets of destiny. Engage in the ultimate trial of survival of the fittest.

Ascension will test your gaming skills like no other.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2958900/Ascension_The_Immortal_Alchemist/]Wishlist[/url] and get yourself on the leaderboards first!
